_doc: Nemesis dialogue (docs/NEMESIS.md). Each entry: id, on (the situation), when (conditions on recorded facts), say (variations). Placeholders: {player} {npc} {wins} {losses} {fights} {days} {form} {npcform} {technique} {newtech} {rank} {rival}.

say: So you're the fighter everyone keeps whispering about. You don't look like much.
A scouter couldn't even be bothered to beep at you. Let's fix that.
I'll make this quick. A Saiyan doesn't waste time on small fry.
You've got an interesting ki. Show me what it can do!
Finally, someone worth testing myself against.
I've heard about you, {player}. Let's see if the rumours hold up!
I am {npc}. Let this be a fair fight.
You stand ready. Good. I'll hold nothing back.
Face me properly, {player}, and I'll do the same.
W-wait, you're the one they warned us about? Fine... fine! Come on, then!
I've got backup, you know! Somewhere!
Another local who thinks they can stand up to us.
Orders are orders. Nothing personal, {player}.
You'll make a fine example for the others.
Let's see what you're made of.
You picked the wrong place to wander into.
{npc}. Remember the name. You won't get the chance to forget it.
You beat me last time. I haven't forgotten.
Round two, {player}. This time it ends differently.
I've been replaying our last fight every night since.
You're back? I thought I'd already taught you your lesson.
Still standing, I see. Want another beating?
{player} again. Did you train at all since I put you down?
How many times is this now? {fights}? I suppose that makes us rivals.
Every time we fight, you're a little stronger. So am I.
{wins} wins for me, {losses} for you. Let's change the score.
You left me alive last time. I owe you a real fight for that.
I don't forget mercy, {player}. Nor do I let it go unanswered.
You SPARED me? Do you have any idea how that felt?
Pity from you is worse than any wound. You'll regret it.
It's been {days} days. I wondered when we'd cross paths again.
Long time, {player}. I hope you've been training. I have.
You again.
We meet again, {player}.
I had a feeling I'd run into you.
Remember me, {player}? I've changed since then. Let me show you how much.
I trained until my body broke, and then I broke through. Behold!
I learned {newtech} just for you. Let's put it to use!
Last time you had the edge. Now I have {newtech}.
A Saiyan gets stronger every time he's beaten. You made a mistake letting me live!
Every bruise you gave me made me stronger. Time to return the favour.
I've thought of nothing but this moment since you beat me.
You took everything from me that day. I'm here to take it back.
I said I'd find you. I always keep my word.
You let me walk away. That was your mistake.
You showed me mercy. I'm not here to return it.
You beat me last time, but I've been training ever since!
Did you think that was the end of it?
I'm back, {player}. And this time, I'm ready.
Hey, {player}! I've been itching for a rematch. No holding back!
I'm not here to hate you. I'm here to beat you. There's a difference!
Just the sight of you makes my blood boil.
This ends today, {player}. One way or another.
I'll keep coming until one of us can't.
{wins} to {losses}. You're losing this rivalry, {player}.
Come to even the score? Good luck.
{losses} times you've beaten me. Not today.
I'm tired of losing to you. Today the streak ends.
I've been sparring with {rival} to get ready for you.
{rival} gave me a hard time lately. You'll be easier. I hope.
I've been looking for you, {player}. Rematch. Now.
We're not done, you and I.
How many times have we fought? Doesn't matter. One more.
Surprised? You should always watch your back.
No speeches this time.
You let your guard down, {player}!
Oh, {player}! Good timing. Want to spar?
I'm working on something new. Want to help me test it?
You caught me training. I've been pushing myself since we last met.
Spying on my training, {player}? Go away. Or don't, and find out what I've learned.
I'm busy getting stronger. Unless you want to be my sparring dummy.
Hmph. Don't think this means I'll go easy on you next time.
Back off! Nobody beats {player} but me!
You're interfering with MY rival. Get lost!
I didn't come all this way to watch someone else win.
I'll take the left, partner!
All that sparring was for moments like this. Let's go!
Hang on, {player}! I've got your back!
I used to fight you. Today I fight with you.
Looks like you could use a hand.
Pathetic. Was that really everything?
Know your place, {player}.
Don't waste my time again until you're worth it.
A good fight. Rise when you're ready.
You fought well. Train hard, and face me again.
That's {wins} times now. Are you even trying?
Again? You really don't learn, do you?
You're still not strong enough. Come back when you've trained more!
That's how it's done.
Stay down.
I... underestimated you. It won't happen twice.
Impossible...! Who ARE you?
Remember my face, {player}. You'll see it again.
This isn't over. Not by a long shot.
Heh... you'd better finish me. A Saiyan who survives comes back stronger.
This pain... I'll turn it into power.
Again...? How do you keep doing this?
{losses} times... I'm starting to hate that look on your face.
Ngh... not bad...
I'll... remember this...
You got lucky.
I won't finish you. Get stronger, then come find me.
Killing you now would be a waste. I want a better fight than this.
Live, {player}. I want to beat you at your best.
Nope! Not today!
I'll get you next time! Probably!
This isn't over!
Tch. I'll be back.
Enjoy it while it lasts.
So you've finally achieved {form}... I've been waiting to see that power!
That golden aura... so the legend is real.
A new form? Cute. It won't save you.
Changing your hair won't change the outcome.
{form}... this changes things. Careful now.
Your power just jumped. I need to rethink this.
{form}?! Now THIS is a fight!
So that's your true power. Good!
I've been saving this for you, {player}. {npcform}!
You've never seen this before. Nobody has!
Enough playing around!
Let me show you my real power!
You forced my hand, {player}.
Good to see you, {player}. Still training?
Next time we spar, I'm winning. Just so you know.
We've come a long way since that first fight, huh?
Not here. Not now. But soon, {player}.
Enjoy the peace while it lasts.
{wins} to {losses}. Don't think I've forgotten.
You're a strong one, {player}. I respect that.
I've heard a lot about you lately.
What do you want?
Hm? You're {player}, aren't you.
I'm {npc}. Remember it.
Good session! Same time tomorrow?
I used to hate losing to you. Now I think you've made me a better fighter.
That's enough for today. You're getting faster.
That's enough. Good spar, {player}.
Phew! Let's call it there.
